/.name: division
/.plain: a / b divides and rounds toward zero (-7 / 2 = -3); b = 0 gives NaN.

%.name: remainder
%.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.

- (unary).name: negation
- (unary).plain: - a is the negation of a.

@.name: reverse decimal digits
@.plain: a @ reverses the decimal digits of |a| and keeps the sign of a (120 @ = 21, -123 @ = -321).

#.name: signed triangular number
#.plain: # a is sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2, computed exactly; only its result is checked against the bound (# 4 = 10, # -4 = -10).

$.name: one-bit count
$.plain: a $ is the number of 1 bits in the binary form of |a| (7 $ = 3).

&.name: signed digit sum
&.plain: & a is sign(a) times the sum of the decimal digits of |a| (& -123 = -6).
